Whether Theodyn will hand over the message below level 20 if you find him in the Bannered Mare yourself isn't shown; his opening line's conditions aren't in these files beyond the quest not having begun.

Lurius gives Barrow of the Wyrm next, but the check on this quest being finished isn't in these files.

The spot on the road where the mercenaries wait has no name or hold in these files, so the hold is left blank. Athir himself has a package to wait there; the other mercenaries can be at the Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath instead.
Ancient's Ascent is a dragon lair in the records with its own boss dragon (Krahjotdaan, leveled 30-79) besides Vulthurkrah.
